title: Customer and item posting fields controlled fit decision
purpose: Decide the next safe customer/item posting-field route after TARGET-044D exposed some standard card context but did not prove enough visible field/value truth for a write.
entryCriteria: TARGET-036D2H has parked vendor numbering or selected a separate vendor gate.
U-CUST-100 and U-ITEM-HW100 exist as basic records, but posting/VAT/O2C readiness is not proven.
acceptanceCriteria: No Business Central or Playwright execution occurs in this decision case.
The decision names exact customer/item fields that would need values before O2C/P2P.
The decision separates field visibility from field correctness.
The next case is either a materially new read-only UI/source route or a small controlled write gate with exact field/value scope.
Preview Posting, Posting and documents remain locked.

nextStepDecision.lastEvidenceSummary: TARGET-044D observed U-CUST-100 and U-ITEM-HW100 via expanded standard pages, but did not expose enough posting/VAT field truth for a write. TARGET-036D2H is expected to park vendor numbering if Manual Nos remains unproven.
nextStepDecision.reason: A no-write fit decision is the smallest safe next step before any customer/item posting field write, O2C draft, Preview Posting or Posting.

lookaheadReviewed.reason: If exact field/value targets are still missing, a source mapping case is the safest follow-up.
Only useful if TARGET-045 identifies exact missing fields and a materially different route from 044C/044D.
O2C remains blocked until customer/item posting fields, VAT and expected posting traces are explicit.
Vendor creation remains blocked if U-VEND Manual Nos is parked by D2H.

nextStepDecision.whySelectedNextCaseIsBest: It prevents another blind customer/item field write and keeps documents, Preview Posting and Posting locked.
risksBeforeNextCase: Do not treat card field visibility as posting readiness.
Do not create or edit any master data in this decision case.
Do not revive U-VEND vendor creation while Manual Nos is parked.
requiredPreparation: Read posting-group and VAT park boundaries.
List exact field/value gaps before selecting any write route.
